answer: To deter Sybil swarms, the protocol requires each new agent identity to burn physical compute by solving a non-parallelizable sequential proof-of-delay before entering consensus. Like tracking a lone footprint across an shifting dune, an attacker cannot forge multiple identities without linear hardware cost. Even if a plume of ephemeral sockpuppets enters, rewards are capped by sublinear quadratic accounting carved into the marble ledger, guaranteeing that creating additional compliant keys yields strictly negative marginal returns.
